recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore 421967003 from the DSTU1 resolution, because FHIR-19296 superseded that detail with the later 736542009 dose-form hierarchy. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5992 unless a future terminology decision changes the dose-form hierarchy again.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy issue reported that http://hl7.org/fhir/vs/medication-form-codes expanded to administration routes instead of medication forms, with a resolution to fix the Medication.product.form binding/value set to SNOMED CT descendants of 421967003.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was fixed in svn 6615. Git commit c74b8e3ebb is that application trail and changed source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009, a route-of-administration parent, to 421967003 for medication forms.
additional_context: Later Published Pharmacy issue FHIR-19296 intentionally changed the medication form parent from 421967003 to 736542009. FHIR-22272 was marked duplicate of FHIR-19296, and FHIR-24700/FHIR-25441 treat later 736542009 expansion failures as tooling issues rather than a reason to restore route codes or the older parent. The combined branch already has an audit commit for FHIR-19296.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml includes SNOMED CT concept is-a 736542009, and Medication.doseForm plus MedicationKnowledge.definitional.doseForm bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-form-codes. Medication and MedicationKnowledge are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini.
